impact: Running 'cargo run --bin sd27_gen_book_cache advanced_race_guide' to regenerate 13 corrected spell records also rewrote 201 equipment records and LICENSE.json, destroying downstream state: enrich_equipment_raw_tokens.rs's raw_tokens/raw_bonus_chains/cost_gp enrichment was wiped from every equipment record, and LICENSE.json's records_processed fell from 635 to 479 (ingest_race_traits_arg.rs's 156 racial-trait records dropped out of the count) with the racial-trait clause removed from product_identity_note. A further 266 records were rewritten with only a new ingested_at.
resolution: Reverted all 467 non-spell files with git checkout, keeping only the 13 spell records whose description text genuinely changed. Verified afterwards that only 13 files remain modified under data/corpus/.
summary: sd27_gen_book_cache is not idempotent against the checked-in corpus: it clobbers later enrichment passes

reason: They are written by a different generator (src/rules_core/cache_gen/apg.rs via src/bin/gen_cache_apg.rs), which is outside this run's granted write scope, and re-running it carries the same non-idempotency hazard just hit with sd27_gen_book_cache (recurrence-key sd27-gen-book-cache-not-idempotent). No player is affected today: the Spell Catalog and the Add Spell picker render from the rules_tables consts through spell_catalog.rs, which now applies render_pcgen_desc, so all three read correctly on screen; corpus_full.rs loads equipment only, so these JSON records reach no surface.
